paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of precipitation-hardened cast high-entropy superalloys

evidence.quote: In this paper, cast precipitation-hardened high-entropy superalloys (HESAs) Ni48−xCo18Cr10.5Fe9.3Al9.7Ti4.5Mox (at.-%, x = 1, 2, 3) were designed and prepared.
